name: Pinni
instructions: 1. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and fry the edible gum until puffed, then set aside.
2. In the same ghee, roast the wheat flour on low heat until it turns golden brown and aromatic.
3. Add chopped nuts and melon seeds to the flour, roasting for another two minutes.
4. Remove from heat and stir in the dried ginger powder and cardamom powder.
5. Melt the jaggery separately to create a syrup or use powdered sugar once the flour mixture has cooled slightly.
6. Combine the fried gum and sweetener into the flour mixture while warm.
7. Shape the mixture into small, firm round balls (pinnis) using your palms before it cools completely.
description: Pinni is a traditional Haryanvi winter delicacy known for its medicinal and warming properties. Often prepared during the cold months to boost immunity, it is considered a wholesome energy snack and is culturally significant as a popular gift during festivals and family celebrations.
